note: Two-column page. Left ELEMENTARY SCHOOL cafeteria (Nass, Deming, Hitchew, Hare, Landry, Thibodeau) = passios (inferred). Right CAFETERIA SUBSTITUTES (Chartrand B., Doucette, Gasco, Forest, Jokinen, Musgrove, Ritari, Thompson) have no building = district-wide. Lay Lunchroom Personnel: Elementary School Cafeteria (Carlson, Gilchrest) and Elementary Annex Multi-purpose Room (Dalbeck, Krauss) = passios. School Bus Contractors (l25+) are contractors, not school staff, but are named individuals on the roster page; entered as district-wide with role 'School Bus Contractor' and bus numbers; 'LHS' l37 is a stray fragment. Role/tenure fragments sit on following lines. Honorifics dropped. The interleaved column order is a best reading of Textract's output; moderate uncertainty on which side Doucette (l4) and Forest (l7) belong (taken as substitutes). Integration pass, 31 Oct 2026: school bus contractors, drivers and volunteers moved from entries to ignored (not school staff; every 1971-1980 page treated alike), and `middle` written `turkey-hill` -- the 1972 and 1974 listings print the building as `Turkey Hill Middle School (Grades 5-7)`, the town's one middle school.
